STRATEGY: The parent is a conditional cooperator with probing/exploit mode, reciprocal forgiving TFT, and last-round defection. The trace simulates its own strategy against the report's probe opponents (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and against slot1/slot3. It changes the strategy by adding a single probe at round 5, exploit mode when no retaliation and low opponent defection, reciprocal mode with punishment for unprovoked defection, and defection on the last round.
